刚搬来时，图书馆很适合成为一个不急着消费、可以慢慢熟悉社区的地方。但第一次别把目: When you've just moved, the library can be a place to get to know the neighborhood without pressure to spend. Don't make your first goal activating every resource in one day. Go with one practical question: find a quiet seat, borrow a book you can finish, or learn how to sign in to a course. Do that one thing first, then decide how the library fits into your routine.
先挑常去的馆，再研究能办哪些卡: Choose a branch you'll use, then check which cards you can get
先把家、公司或学校附近的分馆放进地图，看你能否顺路到达。总馆更大，每周常去的却未: Put branches near home, work, or school on your map and see whether they fit your usual route. A larger main library isn't always the one you'll visit every week. The Bay Area has separate library systems. Even when each calls it a library card, application, pickup, renewal, and digital access rules differ from library to library. Don't fill out forms based only on a friend's experience in another city.
办卡前，把资格和核验分开看: Separate eligibility from verification before applying
Oakland Public Library 面向加州居民；线上申请后，借实体书: Oakland Public Library serves California residents. After applying online, you still need to verify your identity before borrowing physical books. See its card page for documents and verification deadlines. Berkeley Public Library also serves California residents and requires in-person card pickup. If you lack proof of address, see the Easy Access Card terms; that card still requires identification.
打开所选图书馆自己的办卡页，看你的年龄、居住情况适用哪种卡。: Open your chosen library's own card application page and check which card fits your age and residency.
按该馆清单准备证件和地址材料；暂住、材料不齐时先问工作人员。: Prepare the ID and address documents listed by that library. If you're staying temporarily or missing documents, ask staff first.
查计划到访分馆的开放与临时关闭通知，不只看地图上的默认时间。: Check your intended branch's hours and temporary closure notices, not just the default hours on a map.
记下卡号、登录入口和核验下一步；卡号、PIN 不发在公开帖子里。: Note your card number, login page, and next verification step. Don't post your card number or PIN publicly.
数字资源从图书馆入口进入: Access digital resources through the library
想练英语、补办公技能或看技术课程，可以从 SFPL 的 eLearning 页按: To practice English, build office skills, or take technology courses, browse SFPL's eLearning page by topic. It lists language and career resources and notes that some courses are only accessible within California. Read the selected resource's details before signing in; a service offered by one library is not necessarily available through every library.
第一次只试一个目标，例如用二十分钟完成一节听力课。若被要求付费，先返回馆方入口，: Try one goal at first, such as finishing a listening lesson in twenty minutes. If you're asked to pay, return to the library's link and check whether you accidentally opened a personal subscription page. If the login steps are unclear, note the error and ask a librarian; don't give your password to an intermediary. For e-books, also check hold, return, and offline reading instructions.
用图书馆卡借博物馆票和公园通行证: Borrow museum tickets and park passes with a library card
旧金山 · SFPL Discover & Go：旧金山市县居民用借书证号和 P: San Francisco · SFPL Discover & Go: residents of the City and County of San Francisco log in at sfpl.discoverandgo.net with their card number and PIN to reserve tickets to museums, science centers, zoos and theaters; up to 2 reservations at a time, up to 3 months ahead, with passes released on the 1st of the month for two months later. Once a pass is printed or downloaded it cannot be canceled, so print it just before you go.
北湾 · Marin County Free Library 的 Discove: North Bay · Discover & Go at Marin County Free Library: reserve online and print it yourself; you must be 14 or older, live in Marin County and hold a Marin County Free Library or other MARINet card. The Bay Area Discovery Museum in Sausalito has its own physical pass, requested and checked out like a book.
北湾 · Marin 公园通行证：三种，各管不同地点（Marin Municip: North Bay · Marin park passes: three kinds, each for different places (Marin Municipal Water District lots such as Sky Oaks and Lake Lagunitas; Mount Tamalpais State Park lots such as Pantoll and East Peak; and more than 200 California State Parks); hang it from the mirror; they check out for 1 week and renew twice if no one is waiting.
半岛 · San Mateo County：县图书馆免费借县公园通行证，借期 3: Peninsula · San Mateo County: county libraries lend a park pass free for three weeks that covers the San Mateo County Parks vehicle entry fee. CuriOdyssey sits inside Coyote Point Recreation Area, and its parking entry fee and museum tickets are paid separately.
Marin County Free Library 的 LOTE4Kids 有: Marin County Free Library’s LOTE4Kids has more than 3,000 digital picture books with audio and text in more than 65 languages; for more Chinese books and storytimes, see our Bay Area Chinese resource map.
找活动时，看清年龄、地点与报名: Check ages, location, and registration for events
Berkeley 官网集中提供活动日历、分馆时间、数字资源及电脑打印入口。先选日: Berkeley's website brings together its event calendar, branch hours, digital resources, and computer and printing information. Choose a date, branch, and suitable age range, then open the individual event page to see whether it needs registration or has a waitlist. For your first visit, choose a focused event of manageable length and leave time afterward to learn how borrowing and returns work.
把空间和特殊权益单独确认: Check spaces and special benefits separately
需要自习、线上面试或小组讨论时，先问安静区、说话区以及房间预约规则；有座位不等于: For studying, an online interview, or a group discussion, ask about quiet zones, conversation areas, and room reservation rules. An available seat doesn't necessarily allow a long meeting. Check the branch's printing fees and computer booking process, too. Berkeley's tool lending has separate age and local residency or property ownership requirements. Its official pass information also applies to Berkeley resident cardholders. Being eligible for a card does not mean you can use every benefit.
让它变成可持续的小习惯: Make it a small habit you can keep
试着留一个固定的到馆窗口：归还一本书、查一次活动、完成一个学习任务就回家。带孩子: Try setting a regular library visit: return a book, check an event, finish a learning task, and head home. Let children choose a small goal. With a study partner, first meet briefly in a public area and agree whether you want quiet reading or conversation practice. Don't present a private meetup as a library-run event or use a room without the required reservation.
